categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches `src/i2p.cpp`, modifying the I2P SAM bridge connection protocol and outbound peer reachability handling.
categories.rationale: Directly passing base32 addresses to SAM `STREAM CONNECT` eliminates a redundant IPC roundtrip and ensures unresolvable peers are treated as reachability failures rather than proxy errors. This allows AddrMan to correctly record failed connection attempts for unreachable I2P peers.
